kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتمسكن (form IIq)
# نَتَمَسْكَنُ (natamaskanu) /na.ta.mas.ka.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَمَسْكَنَ (tamaskana)
# نَتَمَسْكَنَ (natamaskana) /na.ta.mas.ka.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَمَسْكَنَ (tamaskana)
# نَتَمَسْكَنْ (natamaskan) /na.ta.mas.kan/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَمَسْكَنَ (tamaskana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
